title: Xbox Controller Elite Series Case
author: Dynarun
description:
This xbox controller box is based on the popular rugged box from whity.

The last layer of the tip is not printed so that there is no excessive pressure when the tip presses into the NBR sealing cord.

- Plate 1: Box
- Plate 2: Box with USB C passthrough
- Plate 3: Lid single color
- Plate 4: Lid with “Elite Series” Logo
- Plate 5: Lever
